environment.filesystem_permissions_scope: actual POSIX stat, separately from Git modes

limitations: This result applies to the exact commit tested; a later migration HEAD needs its own clone check.
Git clone preserves the declared file bytes and executable-bit projection, not every ZIP metadata field.
The original verifier checks archived recorded bytes and relationships, not a new implementation execution or interoperability.
The selected SHA-256 source is public and dated after the historical release; this check does not establish continuous asset non-replacement.
The freeze is an unsigned inventory; successful binding checks are not a signature or independent timestamp.
Collection validation checks the stated schema, catalog, manifests and local link targets, not every historical claim or remote link availability.
This run is in the publisher-controlled environment; it is not an independent external reproduction.

whole_tree_path_checks.scope: Listed names and modes; not a claim of portability to all filesystems.

current_freeze_binding_result.record_classification: Unsigned YAML inventory and transcription-correction record.
limits: Caller-supplied metadata pins select the comparison source; their historical provenance is not established by this script.
The cited metadata source is postpublication. Matching observed bytes does not prove continuous non-modification or a publication-time commitment.
No signature, trusted timestamp, authorship, human review, or Git tag is verified.
No historical PASS, provenance, supersedes history, or unaffected-semantics declaration is revalidated.
Only the root manifest member is read from the ZIP; payload hashes, extraction safety, modes, and fresh-clone behavior require separate checks.
No WEXP or EMILIA implementation is executed. PASS establishes only the listed input and byte/binding conditions.

current_archive_inspection_summary.scope_limit: Passing covers only the listed checks and this source archive. Fresh-clone byte/mode checks and an explicit Git projection remain required before accepting a migration.

public_path_normalization.operation: String replacement of local execution paths only; no check, result, byte identity or timestamp removed.
public_path_normalization.stream_hashes: stdout_sha256 and stderr_sha256 identify the raw retained streams, before displayed execution paths are normalized.
public_path_normalization.evidence_boundary: The public detail carries all listed checks. Its raw counterpart contains only equivalent unnormalized execution paths, not additional authority or private evidence.
